decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission P/4685/20 dated 14/12/2021

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">No new window(s) or door(s),
other than those detailed within the proposed drawings shall be installed on
any elevation(s) of the building without the prior permission in writing of the
local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby permitted
shall be used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the
provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or
without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall
take place.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby approved
shall not be first occupied until a Fire Safety Statement has been submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall
include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">1) identify suitably positioned
unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b)
appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">2) is designed to incorporate
appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious
injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and
passive and active fire safety measures <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">3) is constructed in an
appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">4) provide suitable and
convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building
users <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">5) develop a robust management
strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published
(details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published
to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">6) provide suitable access and
equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the
development.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be operated
in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><br></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span style="text-align: start;">(Discharged Planning Reference: PL/1965/24)</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the plans hereby
approved, works relating to the installation of the reinstated revealed
courtyard shall not be commenced until details of its external materials and
finishes and/or samples have been submitted to, and approved in writing by the
local planning authority. This shall include details on flooring, and the new
flat roof over the courtyard. (Discharged planning reference: PL/2662/24)<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the approved
plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of
proposed refuse and cycle parking stores have been submitted to, and approved
in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The submitted details shall
include proposed elevation details of the refuse and cycle stores together with
sample details of the proposed external materials. The submitted drawings shall
be to a scale of 1:20. The development shall be carried out in accordance with
the details as so agreed prior to the first occupation of the development and
shall be retained thereafter. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The refuse bins shall be stored
at all times, other than on collection days in the designated refuse storage
areas detailed on Drawing No. 1122 P11C.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Other than when in use, cycles
shall be stored at all times within the designated areas detailed on Drawing
No. 1122 P11C.</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US"><o:p><br></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US"><o:p>(Discharged Planning Reference: PL/195/24)</o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the plans hereby
approved, the installation of new and replacement external windows and doors
shall not be commenced until details of the new and replacement external
windows and doors in the form of scaled elevation and section drawings to a
scale of 1:10 or 1:20 and/or samples have been submitted to, and approved in
writing by the local planning authority<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;">(Discharged Planning Reference: PL/1965/24)</p>

<p></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby permitted shall be carried
out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Planning
Statement, Office Viability Report, Transport Statement, Design and Access
Statement Rev A, Heritage Impact Assessment Revision 1, Covering Letter (Dated
28/11/2021), 1122 P01, 1122 P02, 1122 P03B, 1122 P04C, 1122 P05C, 1122 P06,
1122 P07A, 1122 P08, 1122 P09, 1122 P10, 1122 P11C, 1122 P12C, 1122 P13C, 1122
P14C, 1122 P15C, 1122 P16A, 1122 P17A, 1122 P18A, 1122 P19A, 1122 P20B, 1122
P21B, 1122 P28.&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p></p><p>Documents submitted with this application ref: PL/1275/26: Application form, Covering latter dated 5th May
2026, Harrow email chain on SBD Issues, Harrow email chain on SBD Issues 2,
EUROSPEC Product Datasheet 2 Star Security Escutcheon AEB1750, Security Glass
Specification, Secondary glazing to all accessible windows is PAS24 and Secured
By Design certified, Bike stores are Secured By Design certified and also Sold
Secure Bicycle ‘Gold’ standard.</p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p></o:p></p><p><span lang="EN-US" style=""><br></span></p>
